+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: AgentRunner restores a recorded child run from disk with tools and instructions from the current config, as an idle run
+---
+## What
+Give a host a way to restore a recorded sub-agent run from disk. The host is FoundationModelsACPAgent: on `session/resume` it must restore the whole tree of nested sessions, with the children idle (user decisions, 2026-11-03). Only this package can build a child, so the restore must live here.
+
+Why this package: a child session is made in `AgentSessionMaker.makeSession(for:family:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentSessionMaker.swift`) from the agent definition: the body and skills, the AGENTS.md files, the model slot (`ModelMatch`), the compaction budget, and the tools. The tools come from `definition.tools` and `definition.disallowedTools` over the catalog `environment.tools`, plus an `agents` tool made for this run with its parent, depth and family (`tools(for:as:)`, private). A host cannot build this. A Router restore (`restoreSession(...tools:)`) takes tool instances from the caller, so a host that restores a child would give it the tools of the root, which can be tools the child was not allowed to have.
+
+USER RULE (2026-11-03): the tools and the instructions of a restored child come from the CURRENT config, never from the recording. Changing the tools config is a main reason to kill and resume a session. The recording holds tool names only so a mismatch can be reported. So the restore builds the child from the current definition in the registry, with the current catalog, as a new child would be built.
+
+Facts (read in the code):
+- A recorded session has `agentID`, `agentName`, `slot`, `instructions` and `agentSpawn` (`parentSessionId`, `parentToolCallId`) in its `SessionRecord` (FoundationModelsRouter).
+- The session of a run has the id of the run (`AgentRun.id`). `AgentRun.caller` is the session id of the caller.
+- An `AgentRun` ends when its session is idle, and then it closes its session: "a finished run holds no session" (`AgentRun.swift` header). `AgentRunState` has the terminal states finished, failed and cancelled. So a finished child is not a live runtime today.
+- `AgentRunner` keeps the run index, the run limit, and the children (`Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRunner.swift`).
+
+Do (design first; write the design in a task comment and discuss it with the user before the code):
+1. Add an API on `AgentRunner`, such as `restore(sessionID: ULID, caller: ULID?) async throws -> AgentRun`. It reads the record, finds the definition by `agentID` in the registry, builds the instructions and the tools from the CURRENT definition and catalog (same code path as `makeSession`, shared, not copied), restores the Router session with those tools, and returns a run linked to its caller with the right depth and family.
+2. Decide how to show a restored child. It is idle: no work runs. Options: a new idle state of `AgentRunState`; or a finished run whose session is reopened on demand. Write the choice and its effect on `check agent`, `send agent`, `cancel agent`, the run limit and the retained runs.
+3. Errors: a definition that no longer exists, an agent that the current config forbids, a model slot that no longer resolves, an unreadable record. Each gives a typed error that a host can report per child. The host announces such a child as unknown with the reason.
+4. Return the restore report of the Router (missing tools, context mismatch) so the host can log it.
+5. A restored child must be usable by its caller again with `send agent` (the RFD says a child is reusable and idle does not end it). Say in the task comment what changes in the `agents` tool for this.
+6. Do not change FoundationModelsRouter from this task. If the Router lacks a public call that the restore needs, write the gap in a task comment.
+
+Out of scope here (a later card): completing the ORIGINAL `start agent` run of the caller when a re-driven child ends. It needs the Router write-ahead card (`01M6GK7RHHHC6B6QMJ25FT1QDT`) and the claim API card (`01M6GK8K45DRDT6B4SHB9V60ED`), both on the Router board.
+
+Consumer: FoundationModelsACPAgent board, tag `subagents`, task "Cold resume: restore the recorded nested sub-agent sessions with their parent, idle, with tools from the CURRENT config" (`01M6GJPPXWKQJ9E6SK5WD0CWZ7`). That task is blocked by this card.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `AgentRunner.restore` restores a recorded child run, at depth 1, 2 and 3, linked to its caller, idle.
+- [ ] The restored child has the tools and the instructions of the CURRENT definition: change `disallowedTools` between the run and the restore, and the restored child follows the new config.
+- [ ] A definition that is gone, a forbidden agent, an unresolved model slot and an unreadable record each give a distinct typed error.
+- [ ] The restore shares code with `makeSession`; no second copy of the tool build.
+- [ ] A restored child can get a new message with `send agent` (or the task comment says why not and what replaces it).
+- [ ] The restore counts against the run limit and the depth limit like a new run.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentRunnerRestoreTests.swift`: record a nested run with the stub model, restore at three depths, config change, each error, send agent, limits.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter AgentRunnerRestoreTests`. All pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
\ No newline at end of file
